_doc: MVC2 wire stage_id (@0x8C289638) -> STGxx disc file index. stage_id is NOT a 0-based file index. Confirmed entries are byte-exact live captures (re_kb 26); the rest resolve by the id->file fallback until captured. Mirror of web/webgpu/stage-client.mjs STAGE_ID_MAP.

0x11.source: re_kb 26 live in-match capture; loaded POL @0x0CEA0000 modelCount=83 uniquely fingerprints STG0B; vertex geometry byte-identical to disc STG0BPOL.BIN

fingerprint_note: modelCount alone is ambiguous (16:[01,0A] 25:[05,0E,0F] 37:[03,04,0C]); modelCount+POLsize+geometry-hash is unique for all 17 EXCEPT 01/0A which are byte-identical POL (shared geometry, different TEX).
_names_doc: Human names per STGxx DISC FILE index (NOT wire stage_id). Format facts extracted from ModNao mvc2StageAttribMappings.ts (github.com/rob2d/modnao, non-commercial license 2026-05-25 — facts only, fresh JSON). Cross-checks: 01/0A share geometry = the two Desert variants; 03/0C share a textureDefsHash = the two Carnival variants; 0B = Training matches our confirmed 0x11->STG0B live capture. Mirror of stage-client.mjs STAGE_NAMES.
